behaviors.$comment: The seven corrections from the behavior sweep, each pinned to its source location. These are the behaviors the SDK now reproduces.

spatial-stage.summary: Five-layer validation order with spatial as a contributed stage; horizontal AND vertical box-span checks.

state-stage.summary: Open-board and duplicate-id rules for exactly six creating actions; dots/shape/count upsert instead.

no-op-revision.summary: advance()/expireMarks() mutate display state without touching doc.revision; the revision tracks committed changes only.
no-op-revision.source: src/board/document.ts:782-789 (advanceReveals returns elements with only reveal progress changed, no revision bump)

write-on-timing.summary: Every created element carries reveal:0 plus its action-specific revealMs (text 700, math 1100, line 500, box 600, arrow 600, highlight 300, scribble 700, dots 900, shape 800, count max(400, total*pace)).

countable-total.summary: countableTotal returns 0 sides for circle/oval (shapes with fewer than three corners have no side midpoints).

center-based-bounds.summary: Line/arrow use midpoint+span with min thickness 2; box stores the supplied center; no corner conversion.

registry-layer-contribution.summary: A plugin may contribute a validation stage at the registry layer; validateCommand runs built-in rules then contributed stages per layer.
